short_description: BORZOI is a first-person survival horror game where you are relentlessly hunted by a giant, demonic Borzoi dog. Experience high tension as you fight for survival, solve high-stakes puzzles, and uncover the dark legacy of a twisted cult—all while evading a predator that cannot be tamed
